tool_args.rationale: The abrupt decline above the critical-gradient range supports the recalled avalanche mechanism. Fit its coefficients and threshold numerically to all eight paid observations, then use fresh confirmation to test the resulting law.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas production
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The targeted observations show a sharp gradient-dependent decline to negative values, which these positive smooth curves do not explain.
The high-gradient probe already brackets the threshold and supplies three post-onset observations, so the specified avalanche mechanism can be fitted and tested first.
